### ST-001

**Initialize the TypeScript monorepo**

*As a **SmartTest contributor**, I want **a pnpm workspace with strict TypeScript, project references and Vitest**, so that **every package builds and tests the same way**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S0 | A01, §4.3 | — |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Given a fresh clone, when I run `pnpm i && pnpm build`, then all packages compile with `strict` and `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` enabled
- [x] `pnpm test` runs Vitest across packages resolving workspace sources without a prior build
- [x] Node engines are pinned to the supported LTS range and enforced

### ST-002

**Define and enforce package boundaries**

*As a **tech lead**, I want **the package map and allowed dependency directions to be machine-checked**, so that **the core never depends on CLI, UI or AI packages**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S0 | A02, §4.2 | [ST-001](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-001) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] The manifest `scripts/packages.manifest.json` is the single source of truth and the scaffolder rejects cycles
- [x] CI fails when a package imports a workspace package not declared in its manifest deps
- [x] `core` has no dependency on any `ai-*` or `studio-*` package (ADR-0004)

### ST-003
